name: tab-collision
title: Tab Collision
description: Single-editor lock across tabs: one tab edits (BroadcastChannel, with a localStorage storage-event fallback), the others become read-only until someone picks "Use this tab", with a confirm when the other tab has unsaved changes.

meta.summary: Lets only one browser tab edit a record at a time, so a save in one tab doesn't silently erase edits in another.
meta.server: Use optimistic concurrency (version or ETag) on save so concurrent edits from anywhere are rejected, not overwritten.
catches: The same record open for editing in another tab of this browser
Taking over while the other tab has unsaved changes (confirm first)
limits: Same browser profile only; other devices, browsers or users are not seen
Read-only mode is up to you to apply using the status
a11y: Notice is a region with an aria-label; message in a polite live region
Buttons have text labels; icons are aria-hidden
